name: Gola Gokarannath
purpose: City-specific cadastral and public parcel geometry investigation; registry evidence, retrieved geometry and runtime qualification are assessed separately.

queries.query: Gola Gokarannath Uttar Pradesh official GIS cadastral map parcel land records
queries.result: First-party results identified the Government of Uttar Pradesh Bhulekh portal, Board of Revenue service page, cadastral-map digitization dashboard, and the current Bhu-Naksha viewer. Search results did not provide an anonymous city-bounded parcel feature response.

queries.query: गोला गोकरणनाथ उत्तर प्रदेश आधिकारिक नक्शा भूलेख खसरा नक्शा
queries.result: First-party Hindi results identified Rajस्व परिषद Uttar Pradesh/Bhulekh land-record and bhu-naksha services. The official DARMS report confirms Gola Gokaran Nath tehsil in Kheri district and lists revenue villages, but search results did not expose city parcel geometry.

officialSources.publisher: Government of Uttar Pradesh / Board of Revenue
officialSources.observation: Official Bhulekh portal describes online land records, plot/gata status and links to bhu-naksha services. It is a state-level custodian, not a city-specific boundary dataset.
Official Hindi service page lists khatauni, khasra and bhu-naksha/shajra services, including revenue-village maps and gata boundaries.

Official report identifies district Kheri and tehsil Gola Gokaran Nath (codes 153 and 00799) and returns the revenue-village catalog. This evidences a local tehsil land-record custodian, not citywide parcel geometry.

officialSources.publisher: Government of Uttar Pradesh / National Informatics Centre
officialSources.observation: Current public Bhu-Naksha viewer loaded with state code 09 and exposes level selection, map extent and plot lookup routes in its JavaScript configuration.

requests.outcome: Current viewer HTML and JavaScript configuration retrieved anonymously over verified TLS; no login or CAPTCHA was used.
Returned district, tehsil and village catalog JSON. District 153 is Kheri; tehsil 00799 is गोला; village results included Gola-area villages but no city parcel geometry.
Returned JSON with gisCode 15300799217899 and attribution for village गोला जेड अन्दर, but xmin/ymin/xmax/ymax were all 0.0. This is an unusable extent, not evidence of citywide absence.
Returned an empty JSON object. The request used the exact immutable WUP point as a bounded diagnostic; the viewer CRS was not qualified and a zero hit is not absence evidence.
Returned an empty JSON object; no geometry or stable native parcel identity was qualified.

registryBasis: Official Uttar Pradesh revenue sources identify the Gola Gokaran Nath tehsil land-record/cadastral service and the current public Bhu-Naksha viewer. This is registry/cadastre-service evidence only; no city-bounded parcel geometry or anonymous schema was verified.

sourceCandidate.publisher: Government of Uttar Pradesh / National Informatics Centre
sourceCandidate.scope: Gola Gokaran Nath tehsil is evidenced; city coverage, public geometry access, CRS and stable native parcel schema remain unverified
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if exposed

schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: The viewer's administrative lookup used district 153 + tehsil 00799 + village code; no parcel-level composite identity was returned.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Gola Gokaran Nath tehsil land records and cadastral-map viewer
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Administrative levels and viewer routes were verified; citywide parcel polygon coverage, CRS, safe native ID, and anonymous feature retrieval were not verified.

scopeLimits: No credentials, login, CAPTCHA bypass, private tokens or unsafe landholder fields were used.
The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted.
No parcel polygon was retained because no safe native parcel identity and geometry were returned.
A zero exact-point hit, zero map extent, or empty response does not establish citywide absence.
Packet completion is not source integration or admission.
remainingUncertainty: The Bhu-Naksha viewer may contain parcel maps for relevant urban or revenue units, but this attempt did not qualify a city-bounded public geometry response, CRS, parcel schema, or stable native parcel identity. A later attempt may inspect additional administrative units or viewer routes without treating the diagnostic empty responses as absence.
pointBasis: Exact immutable WUP queue point; not shifted to force a parcel hit.
